theme: As It Turned Out (Future in the Past & Complex Time Reference)
phoneme_focus: Weak 'was going to' /wəz ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə/; contracted 'would've'
grammar_pattern: Future in the past & complex time reference

grammar_point.title: Future in the past & complex time reference
grammar_point.en: Refer to a future seen from the past and layered time: was going to, would later, was to become, by which time.
grammar_point.ar: الإشارة لمستقبل من منظور الماضي وزمن متعدّد الطبقات: was going to، would later، by which time.

vocabulary.example: I was going to call, but forgot.
She would later regret it.
He was to become a leader.
We were about to leave when he arrived.
I was on the point of giving up.
By which time, it was too late.
By the time we knew, it had ended.
As it turned out, we were right.
Little did we know what awaited us.
It was destined to fail.
It was bound to happen.
She would go on to win twice.
The flight had been due to leave at noon.
He subsequently apologised.
Eventually, things improved.
Ultimately, the plan worked.
In hindsight, it was a mistake.
In retrospect, we rushed.
We had planned it beforehand.
Thereafter, sales climbed.
Meanwhile, prices kept rising.
Prior to that, we had met once.
Details will follow in due course.
Sooner or later, it happens.
At the outset, we were hopeful.
That was the turning point.
Events began to unfold quickly.
Nobody anticipated the outcome.
We could not have foreseen it.
It culminated in success.
It later transpired that he knew.
There was an impending crisis.

Saturday.prompt: Tell three stories using 'was going to', 'was about to', 'would later'.

Sunday.prompt: Describe how something 'was to become' or 'was destined to' happen.

Monday.prompt: Narrate an event using 'by which time', 'by the time', 'thereafter'.

Tuesday.prompt: Reflect on a past decision with 'in hindsight' and 'in retrospect'.

Wednesday.prompt: Tell a story with a twist using 'as it turned out' and 'little did we know'.

Thursday.prompt: Recount a shared memory with a partner using complex time reference.

Friday.prompt: Narrate an extended story (12-14 sentences) mixing past and future-in-past.

writing_prompts: Write three 'was going to / was about to' sentences with an interruption.
Describe a life path using 'would later', 'was to become', 'would go on to'.
Narrate with layered time markers ('by which time', 'thereafter', 'meanwhile').
Reflect on a decision using 'in hindsight' and 'in retrospect'.
Write a short story with a twist ('as it turned out', 'little did we know').
Write an extended narrative paragraph mixing past tenses and future-in-past.
